nodes.label: Shah et al. 2023 - PV Panel Cleaning and Cooling through Air Conditioner Condensate Water
nodes.author: Ali Hasan Shah, Abdulrahman Alraeesi, Ahmed Hassan, Mohammad Shakeel Laghari

nodes.label: AC Condensate Water for Combined PV Cleaning and Cooling (up to 14% power gain)
nodes.rationale: Synergistic reuse of building air-conditioning condensate addresses both PV soiling and thermal derating in hot desert climates without dedicated water generation hardware.
